beats.config_opened: [CONFIG MENU] play mode / evolution preference / gates — pick one to apply, "back" to return. 正文见 docs/context/acts/settle.md（配置面板）；play.mode 切换会离开本页。
beats.config_keys: play.mode / goal.authorization / executor.<rN>.<analysis|plan|development> / evolution.mode / evolution.max_per_run / gates.require_all_green / review.evolution.artifact / review.evolution.summary / review.evolution.candidates / review.evolution.classes / tools.root / tools.<name> / read.<act>/<doc-id>
beats.read_signed: [SIGNED] {{doc}}@{{ver}} — signed as {{actor}}; this act has {{k}}/{{n}} docs signed, {{mine}} of them by you ({{scene}} — the others may be signed by other actors)
beats.read_signed_unplotted: [SIGNED] {{doc}}@{{ver}} — signed as {{actor}}; no read plan is baked for this act, so coverage is not computed ({{mine}} signature(s) in this act are yours)
beats.read_no_identity: [SIGNED REFUSED] a read signature must be attributable to an actor — pass --actor <id> (or set YGG_ACTOR) on the same command, then sign again; nothing was written
beats.read_cleared: [SIGN] {{doc}} cleared: the signature no longer counts ({{scene}})
beats.read_bad_doc: a read signature needs read.<act>/<doc-id>=<ver>: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, exactly one slash, no dots (got "{{doc}}")
beats.read_bad_ver: the signature version must be 4-40 lowercase hex characters (copy it from the doc header ver line); got "{{ver}}"
beats.read_gate_missing: read-gate/missing: {{count}} doc(s) for {{action}} are unsigned (scope {{scope}}, opened {{gap}} dispatch(es) ago; window {{window}}). Details: {{docs}}. Read then sign each: {{commands}}. If the window is what blocks you, widen it: {{raise}}
beats.read_gate_other_actor: read-gate/other-actor: {{count}} doc(s) for {{action}} were signed by someone else (first: {{docs}} by {{signer}}) — a signature only counts for the actor who signed it, and this action is dispatched as {{actor}}. This act has {{k}}/{{n}} docs signed, {{mine}} of them by you. Read then sign it yourself: {{commands}} (window {{window}}; widen with {{raise}})
beats.read_gate_no_identity: read-gate/no-identity: {{action}} needs {{count}} doc(s) ({{docs}}) but this dispatch carries no actor, so "did the actor read this" cannot be answered. Pass --actor <id> (or set YGG_ACTOR) on the dispatching command, then sign: {{commands}}
beats.read_gate_ticket: [READ GATE · ticket] human ticket for {{action}}: {{k}}/{{n}} signed in this act — signers are NOT distinguished on the ticket path (a menu click carries no actor), so this is a coverage check, not an attribution check
beats.read_gate_no_carrier: [READ GATE · no-carrier] {{action}} accepts only an empty payload (or "0"/"full"), so the host has nowhere to append `|actor=` — attribution is structurally unavailable on this action. Falling back to a coverage check ({{k}}/{{n}} signed in this act); every other dimension still applies
beats.read_gate_stale: read-gate/stale: {{doc}} was signed at dispatch {{sign}}, {{gap}} dispatch(es) ago, but {{reason}} — the signature no longer counts. Window {{window}}. Re-read then sign: {{command}}. If the window is what blocks you, widen it: {{raise}}
beats.read_gate_forgotten: read-gate/forgotten: {{doc}} was signed {{gap}} dispatch(es) ago, past the window {{window}} (dispatch now {{now}}). Re-read then sign: {{command}}. Or widen the window: {{raise}}
beats.read_gate_unvered: [READ GATE] {{action}} needs {{count}} doc(s) but readGate.ver carries no version ledger — version drift cannot be checked and the sign commands cannot be exact. Regenerate the table: python3 scripts/gen-scene-readfirst.py --readset
beats.goal_auth_registered: [GOAL AUTH REGISTERED] {{auth}} (self-declared, not identity proof; the closing check applies only to runs that entered goal at runtime)
beats.goal_auth_pending: [GOAL AUTH PENDING] entered goal mode without goal.authorization; register config.set goal.authorization=<note> before review.note
beats.goal_auth_cleared: [GOAL AUTH CLEARED] a runtime goal run must register it again before closing.
beats.goal_auth_bad: goal authorization must be a single line (non-empty after trim, <= 200 chars, no newline).
beats.goal_auth_required: this run entered goal at runtime: register the run-level authorization before closing with `config.set goal.authorization=<authorization note>` (self-declared; a static goal preset in data/config.json is out of scope).
beats.config_goal_auth: goal authorization: {{auth}} (self-declared, only checked when a runtime goal run closes)
beats.config_goal_auth_none: goal authorization: not registered (only runs that entered goal at runtime need it; a static default is not checked)
beats.executor_unknown_req: executor registration points at a missing requirement: `{{id}}`.
beats.executor_bad_id: an executor id must be non-empty after trim, <= 64 chars, with no whitespace and no `|`.
beats.executor_reason_required: changing the executor requires a reason: `config.set executor.{{id}}.{{stage}}=<new_id>|<reason>` (previous executor {{prev}}; cross-stage handoff needs one too).
beats.tool_replayed: [REPLAY:TOOL] call `{{call_id}}` with external_id `{{ext}}` was already applied — idempotent return, not executed twice.
beats.tool_after_done: the run has reached its ending: no tool call can be requested or settled any more.
beats.tool_not_allowed: tool `{{tool_id}}` is not in data/config.json `allowedTools` (allowed: {{allowed}}) — refused before anything was stored.
beats.tool_usage: tool.call <tool_id>[|<k=v;...>][|<call_id>] — the tool id must be listed in allowedTools; arguments are `k=v` pairs separated by `;`
beats.tool_result_usage: tool.result <call_id>|<tool_id>|<ok|err>|<code>|<output>[|<external_id>] (5 or 6 segments; a vertical bar may not appear inside the output)
beats.tool_bad_tool_id: tool id `{{tool_id}}` must look like `<namespace>.<name>`: lowercase letters/digits/underscore/hyphen in both segments, at most 64 bytes.
beats.tool_bad_call_id: call id `{{call_id}}` is not usable: lowercase letters/digits/hyphen/underscore, 1..{{max}} chars, and not one of count / pending / last / notified.
beats.tool_call_dup: call id `{{call_id}}` already exists ({{status}}); use a fresh id, or resend the same external_id to replay.
beats.tool_capacity: no free tool slot ({{cap}} calls already allocated); settle the pending calls first.
beats.tool_unknown_call: no tool call `{{call_id}}` exists in this run.
beats.tool_result_mismatch: call `{{call_id}}` does not accept this result: expected {{expected}}, got {{got}}.
beats.tool_bad_code: code `{{code}}` must be an integer (use `-1` when the tool never ran).
beats.vfs_usage: usage: `vfs.write` takes `artifacts/<name>.md|<content>` (path must be artifacts/*.md, content 1..{{max}} bytes)
beats.vfs_path_rejected: [VFS PATH REFUSED] {{path}}: only artifacts/<name>.md is writable (no `..`, no whitespace, at most {{max}} bytes)
beats.vfs_ledger_only: [VFS LEDGER ONLY] {{path}} ({{bytes}} B): this host exposes no `ygg.fs`, so nothing reached the disk - the artifact ledger records the Mod-side assertion only
beats.subagent_delta: Resume {{id}} (rev {{rev}}) for stage `{{stage}}` in worktree `{{worktree}}`; write `{{artifact}}` and submit.
beats.reactive_malformed: [PROBE MALFORMED] {{call_id}} ({{tool_id}}): the output is not a `k=v;...` map - nothing was applied
beats.artifact_path_rejected: [ARTIFACT PATH REFUSED] {{path}}: the ledger only accepts artifacts/<name>.md (no `..`, no whitespace, at most {{max}} bytes) | nothing was recorded
beats.executor_bad_actor: an actor id must be non-empty after trim, <= 64 chars, with no whitespace and no quote/backslash (the host injects `actor=`; self-carried segments are rejected).
beats.executor_bad_actor_session: an actor_session id must be non-empty after trim, <= 128 chars, with no whitespace and no quote/backslash (the host injects `actor_session=`; self-carried segments are rejected).
beats.tools_root_registered: [TOOLS ROOT REGISTERED] {{root}} (self-declared; settlement machine cross-checks enabled when this is set)
beats.tools_root_cleared: [TOOLS ROOT CLEARED] settlement checks fall back to human attestation.
beats.tools_root_bad: tools.root must be a directory path: non-empty after trim (empty clears), <= 240 chars, no `..` segment, no `|` or control characters.
beats.tools_relpath_bad: tools.<name> value must be a script path relative to the root: `.sh` suffix, <= 240 chars, no `..`, no `|` or control characters (empty clears the override).
beats.tools_name_registered: [TOOLS NAME REGISTERED] {{name}} -> {{path}} (override for the default <name>.sh; empty path clears it)
beats.tools_param_registered: [TOOLS PARAM REGISTERED] {{name}} = {{value}} (reserved parameter for the settlement cross-check argv)
beats.tools_param_bad: tools parameter value must be non-empty after trim (empty clears), <= 240 chars, no `..` segment, no `|` or control characters.
